table: composition (K-P9-6: atx-equity-strategy-ic --list-rules --json, block theme_hedge, stage hedge)
citation: Daniel, Mota, Rottke and Santos (2020), The Cross-Section of Risk and Returns, Review of Financial Studies 33(5), 1927-1979 (lit [21]; NBER w24164)
claim: a characteristic-sorted portfolio carries the priced characteristic and the unpriced covariance of its names with the characteristic's own factor; a hedge leg that holds the characteristic fixed and is short that loading, scaled by the minimum-variance hedge ratio, removes the unpriced part: squared Sharpe of the optimal five-factor combination 1.31 -> 2.29 (about 1.14 -> 1.51), weights from past returns only (lit section 1.1)
source_sample_basis: DMRS's sample is 1963/07 - 2017/06 ('the sample period covered in this paper (1963/07 - 2017/06)', the sample of the 1.31 -> 2.29 squared Sharpe and of every table); read on 2026-10-03 in the text of NBER w24164 rev0, lit [21]'s URL; the RFS version reports the same 1.31 and 2.29
predicted_mechanism: each theme's composite is long the names that load on the theme's own factor beyond what the theme's characteristic explains; shorting that loading at a walk-forward minimum-variance ratio lowers the book's variance at about the same gross alpha
house_form: per theme t and decision d on the theme's standardised composite R_t (ew-theme-std-v1's re-rank): beta_perp of each name on its own theme sleeve over the trailing 252 decisions ending d - 2, orthogonalised to R_t; h_t by trailing regression re-estimated every 21 decisions; the theme adds W_t (R_t - h_t rank(beta_perp)) (lit section 1.1 'House form'; engine combine/char_cov_hedge.hpp, atx-impl strategy_ic_theme_hedge.cpp)

constants.name: lookback
constants.why: the house's one-year window (plan section 2.4 AL-COMB: windows 252 / 126 / 21 from the house set); the window of every loading and of the hedge ratio

constants.name: lag
constants.why: the house's decision -> fill -> return clock: decision d's book earns the session return of d + 2, so only pairs with d' + 2 <= d enter an estimate (the fitter's factor series f(d) = q . r(d + 2), K-P9-4)

constants.name: step
constants.why: the house's monthly re-estimation (theme-tsmom-v1's step); DMRS re-form monthly

constants.name: min_pairs
constants.why: half the window, the minimum price-risk-v1 requires for a beta; below it a loading (or the hedge ratio) is not estimated and the name (or the theme) is left unhedged

fixed_choices: the score is the theme's standardised re-rank (the composite the book holds), not a raw characteristic
returns are the role's guarded session returns (price-risk-v1's guard, session_interval_returns); an invalid return adds 0 to a sleeve and leaves the pair out of a loading
h_t is the OLS slope (intercept included) of the theme sleeve on the hedge leg's return, 0 before decision 253, below 126 pairs or without variance; held between re-estimates
before h_t's first estimate the composition is the parent's bit for bit; no fitted constant enters the weights file (the fitter writes only the constants block)

predictions.registered_before_any_read: book volatility ratio to the parent < 1; gross alpha ratio to the parent about 1 (plan section 5.2 P9-H, section 5.3 OD-3 predictions)
predictions.expected_effect: +.05 to +.15 net Sharpe [est] (lit section 6 row 1; ERC already took part of the reducible variance; DMRS is monthly, pre-cost, a few characteristics)
